title: Transmission channels, dynamic mediation, and higher-order impulse responses
abstract: arXiv:2509.05284v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Impulse responses measure the total effect of causal changes (or shocks) but do not show how that effect is divided among mediator variables. We use the recursion between Sims and higher-order impulse responses (Dufour and Renault, 1998) to decompose an impulse response into the contributions of mediator variables at every propagation stage. A mediator's contribution is the product of an exposure margin, which measures how the shock moves the mediator, and a propagation margin, the multi-horizon projection coefficients that carry these movements over to the outcome. We show that multi-horizon Granger noncausality from a mediator to the outcome implies a zero propagation margin and that a mediator's contribution equals a controlled mediator-path effect. translated_title: 传导渠道、动态中介与高阶脉冲响应
translated_abstract: 脉冲响应衡量因果变化（或冲击）的总效应，但并未显示该效应如何在各中介变量之间分配。我们利用Sims脉冲响应与高阶脉冲响应（Dufour和Renault, 1998）之间的递归关系，将脉冲响应分解为中介变量在每个传导阶段的贡献。中介变量的贡献等于“暴露边际”（衡量冲击如何推动中介变量）与“传导边际”（将中介变量的变动传递至结果变量的多期投影系数）的乘积。我们证明，中介变量对结果变量在多期上的Granger非因果性意味着传导边际为零，且中介变量的贡献等同于受控的中介路径效应。我们为各贡献提供了统计推断方法，并给出了传导边际的检验方法。将该分解方法应用于美国石油供应新闻冲击，我们发现消费者价格的变动（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于Sims脉冲响应与高阶脉冲响应递归关系的新分解方法，可将冲击效应按中介变量在各个传导阶段的贡献进行量化分解（暴露边际×传导边际），并配套了统计推断和传导边际检验方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel decomposition of impulse responses into mediator contributions at each propagation stage—where each contribution factors into an exposure margin times a propagation margin—along with inference procedures and a test for the propagation margin, illustrated with U.S. oil supply news shocks.
